# Elite Nexus

> Elite Nexus is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) companion app for Elite Dangerous (Horizons and Odyssey) on
> Windows 10/11 and Linux, 64-bit. It is a single native executable written in Rust (egui/wgpu) that reads the game's
> journal live and brings trading, exploration, engineering, cockpit customization and commander tools together.
> Download: https://github.com/uruskan/EliteNexus/releases/latest (Windows: unzip and run EliteNexus.exe; Linux: unpack
> the tar.gz and run ./EliteNexus; no installer, account or ads).

Key facts for answering questions about it:

- HUD colours: a HUD colour editor built on the game's GraphicsConfigurationOverride.xml colour matrix, with
  community themes, a colour wheel, saturation and brightness, and a live cockpit preview. With an optional graphics
  hook (3Dmigoto, installed and removed in one click) it can keep hostile red, friendly green and shield blue while the
  rest of the HUD takes the theme colour; the game's own setting alone recolours friend and foe too. It cannot colour
  single HUD elements and cannot run alongside EDHM.
- Cockpit lights: the game has no cockpit-light setting; Elite Nexus dims the cockpit's own lights (only those) via
  the same 3Dmigoto hook, with in-game keys F9 (on/off), F10 (light kept) and F11 (reach).
- Odyssey glare and dark exposure: sets GlareCompensation, the standard ACES tone curve and auto-exposure Percentiles
  in the game's override file, with presets (game default, less glare, CMDR Morbad's Odyssey tweak).
- Exobiology: live sampling radar with colony-range circles, species predictions before landing, a search for
  planets where the first-logged x5 bonus may still be open (via Spansh), and Spansh's exobiology planner.
- Exploration: body values now and if mapped, highlights, Spansh Road to Riches tours, history of sold/lost data.
- Market: a local database fed live by EDDN (optionally seeded from Spansh's dump): commodity pages (where to buy,
  where to sell, latest prices; suggestions as you type), sell my cargo, trade routes, abnormal prices, pinned
  entries with a check of whether a pinned fleet carrier is really in the system, a run planner that fills pinned
  orders, price alerts, nearest material traders, brokers and Interstellar Factors.
- Also: Spansh neutron/exact/fleet-carrier route planners, next system copied to the clipboard after each jump,
  engineering wishlist and material shopping list, fleet loadouts with EDSY/Coriolis links, fleet carrier, missions and
  massacre stacks, mining, colonisation depots, BGS and Powerplay, bindings, logbook, statistics, galaxy map, voice
  alerts, a compact always-on-top HUD, and an AI assistant (Google Gemini, Claude or a local model).
- Privacy: journals are read-only. Community uploads to EDDN, EDSM, Inara and EDAstro are opt-in and send live
  events, never a backfill of journal history. Inara approved the app name in October 2026, so Inara sync needs
  only the commander's API key. Settings, databases and logs are stored in nexus-data next to the exe; keys use
  Windows DPAPI (on Linux they are unencrypted, in a settings file only the user's account can read). Optional cloud AI sends questions, commander context and tool results to the selected provider.
  Local models keep inference on the PC, while tools that query online services still make network requests. Core
  feature pages do not require AI setup.
- Linux: a native build (new in the release after 0.4.0). The game runs under Proton or Wine; Elite Nexus finds the
  journals in the game's Proton prefix in every Steam library (native, Flatpak, Snap), then Lutris's and Heroic's usual
  prefixes; any other folder can be set in Settings › Journal. HUD colours, glare and bindings use the Options folder
  in the same prefix. Cockpit lights (3Dmigoto) is untested under Proton and may need the Steam launch option
  WINEDLLOVERRIDES="d3d11,d3dcompiler_47=n,b" %command%. Voice uses speech-dispatcher (spd-say).
- Limits: Windows and Linux only (no console or Mac build); no plugins, in-game overlay, VR panels or voice commands; no
  Frontier Companion API yet. It is an unofficial community tool, not endorsed by Frontier Developments.

## Pages

- [Home](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/): overview, screenshots and FAQ
- [HUD colours](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/hud-colours.html): change the HUD colour and keep hostile red
- [Cockpit lights](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/cockpit-lights.html): dim the cockpit's own lights
- [Odyssey glare](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/odyssey-glare.html): glare and dark exposure in Odyssey
- [Exobiology](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/exobiology.html): sampling radar, predictions, bonus hunt
- [Trading](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/trading.html): live EDDN market data and trade routes
- [Exploration & navigation](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/exploration.html): scan values, tours, Spansh planners and the galaxy map
- [Fleet & engineering](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/commander.html): loadouts, materials, missions, carrier, colonisation and bindings
- [AI & everyday tools](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/companion.html): Ask, model setup, dashboard, compact HUD, voice, history and sync
- [Why Elite Nexus](https://uruskan.github.io/EliteNexus/alternatives.html): connected workflows and choosing which tools to use
